notes: Introduced one global download queue across every search, so new searches never replace or bypass existing downloads.
Added multi-season searching plus an All available seasons mode that stops intelligently after empty seasons.
Added saved searches, per-series preferences, smart recommendation rules, and named Smart Profiles such as Small HEVC and Best Quality.
Added full recommended auto-selection mode with confirmation before sending releases to AllDebrid.
Added size sanity checks, episode coverage warnings, duplicate detection, local episode conflict checks, and quality-upgrade detection.
Added system-tray support, optional Windows notifications, keyboard shortcuts, and release context menus.
Added bandwidth profiles, scheduled queue starts, and optional automatic pause when download speed stays below a configured threshold.
Expanded History with filters, storage totals, most-downloaded series, session average speed, and failed-download insight.
Added health checks, database backup/repair, and stale temp/log cleanup.
Added update rollback, Stable/Beta update channels, and richer changelog history.
Expanded naming transparency to show whether a clean title came from Groq, an alias, cache, local fallback, or a manual override.
